title: Showcase: the mission, proven
summary: Run the full Mars mission for the family, delay honoured, and show the arc from season 3's bench numbers to today's rover-and-arm run.
materials: the rover with the arm mounted, from week 11
the marked sample and course from week 11
tri-fold science fair board or a large sheet of card
the Maker's Log, open to season 3 week 1 and season 4 week 11

steps.title: Plan the presentation
steps.body:
Set up the exact same course and sample position from week 11. Write the six short-delay and long-delay distances on the board, large enough to read across the room.

Plan the presentation in this order.

1. Show the two seasons' arc: the bench numbers from season 3 week 1, the printed chassis, and today's arm and gripper.

2. Restate the mission plan and the real round-trip delay it is built around.

3. Run the full mission live, delay honoured, drive to the sample and pick it up.

4. Show the board's numbers and say whether the long delay really cost more distance from the sample.

Be ready for one question about what the two seasons of building actually proved.

figure.alt: A showcase layout: the board on the left displays the six delay-test results, the rover with its arm mounted sits on a marked course driving toward the sample on the right, and the family's viewing spot sits above, ready to watch the live run with the delay honoured.

steps.title: Rehearse the run and the answer
steps.body:
Run the full mission once at demo settings on the same course used for the real numbers, with the delay honoured exactly as tested.

Practise the sentence that states the result honestly. Say whether the long delay really left the rover further from the sample, or whether the gap was closer than that.
checklist: The course and sample position match the ones used for the week 11 numbers
The board shows all six short-delay and long-delay results
A full rehearsal run with the delay honoured succeeded beforehand
I can answer one question about what the two seasons proved, honestly

steps.title: Show the family
steps.body:
Gather the family and run the presentation in the order rehearsed: the two-season arc, the mission plan, the live run, and the board's numbers.

Invite one question and answer it as honestly as the data allows. End by naming one thing that would make a real Mars mission's plan more resilient to the delay.

steps.title: Show it
steps.prompt: A short recording of the live mission run in front of the family, plus a photo of the board with all six numbers
